CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.build_followup_identity_key(p_customer_id text, p_customer_code text, p_phone text, p_customer_name text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case
    when nullif(trim(p_customer_id), '') is not null then 'id:' || lower(trim(p_customer_id))
    when nullif(trim(p_customer_code), '') is not null then 'code:' || lower(trim(p_customer_code))
    when nullif(public.normalize_followup_phone(coalesce(p_phone, '')), '') is not null
      then 'phone:' || public.normalize_followup_phone(p_phone)
    when nullif(regexp_replace(lower(trim(coalesce(p_customer_name, ''))), '\s+', '', 'g'), '') is not null
      then 'name:' || regexp_replace(lower(trim(p_customer_name)), '\s+', '', 'g')
    else null
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.daily_followups_set_identity_key()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  new.identity_key := public.build_followup_identity_key(
    new.customer_id,
    new.customer_code,
    coalesce(new.customer_phone, new.phone),
    coalesce(new.customer_name, new.name)
  );
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_followup_phone(p_phone text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
AS $function$
  select case
    when regexp_replace(p_phone, '\D', '', 'g') like '0020%' then '0' || substr(regexp_replace(p_phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 5)
    when regexp_replace(p_phone, '\D', '', 'g') like '20%' then '0' || substr(regexp_replace(p_phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 3)
    when regexp_replace(p_phone, '\D', '', 'g') ~ '^1[0125][0-9]{8}$' then '0' || regexp_replace(p_phone, '\D', '', 'g')
    else regexp_replace(p_phone, '\D', '', 'g')
  end;
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_daily_followups_branch_owner BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF branch, responsible_name, assigned_to ON daily_followups FOR EACH ROW WHEN (current_setting('dawaa.historical_import'::text, true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'on'::text) EXECUTE FUNCTION normalize_customer_service_branch_owner()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_daily_followups_dedupe BEFORE INSERT ON daily_followups FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_followup_dedupe_same_day()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_daily_followups_guard_insert BEFORE INSERT ON daily_followups FOR EACH ROW WHEN (current_setting('dawaa.historical_import'::text, true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'on'::text) EXECUTE FUNCTION daily_followups_guard_insert()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_daily_followups_identity_key BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF customer_id, customer_code, customer_phone, phone, customer_name, name ON daily_followups FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION daily_followups_set_identity_key()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_daily_followups_state_guard_v2 BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF status, followup_status, followup_result, contact_result, evaluation_summary, followup_summary, followup_notes, postponed_until, next_followup_date, is_hidden, hidden_reason, archive_reason, cancelled_at, cancelled_reason, completed_at ON daily_followups FOR EACH ROW WHEN (current_setting('dawaa.historical_import'::text, true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'on'::text) EXECUTE FUNCTION dawaa_guard_daily_followup_state_v2()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_validate_daily_followup_write BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF status, followup_status, completed_at, followup_result, contact_result, next_followup_date, contact_status, archived_at, cancelled_at, is_hidden, is_duplicate, customer_phone, phone ON daily_followups FOR EACH ROW WHEN (current_setting('dawaa.historical_import'::text, true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'on'::text) EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_daily_followup_write()
